name: Settings Panel
description: A tabbed settings section for audio, display, controls, and accessibility preferences. It edits a draft and emits normalized change, apply, and reset requests; audio devices, renderers, input maps, and save systems remain the authorities for applying and storing those values.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Current host-supplied settings keyed by stable setting id.

inputs.name: applyMode
inputs.description: explicit requires Apply; immediate emits a change request after each committed control interaction.

outputs.name: controls
outputs.description: Normalized controls as {settingId, kind, label, value, min, max, options, disabled, description}.

provenance: Added 2026-10-29 with the Adventure Interface Shell UI pack (84ece01). Provenance written after the fact on 2026-10-29: it landed recording only "library-native". A catalogue search found no settings or options component; the audio, display and input components stay the authorities, and this edits a draft of their values. Library-native.
